newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges up $1, Sept swaps jump $6.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges up $1, Sept swaps jump $6.

text.p: NWE gasoline barges were remarkably steady over most of Tuesday after an early gain of around $1, although front month swaps surged ahead by $6.

Three Eurograde barge trades for prompt/balance of August were heard done at $227 fob per tonne, the first involving Rotterdam running refinery, the second done as fob Antwerp and the third fob AR, traders said.
The regular market remained extremely quiet and values were notionally seen $6 below Eurograde and cargoes were barely talked as dealers concentrated on barge activity.
September swap trades were heard during the day at $200, $202 and $202 as levels rose on gathering gains on London and New York futures markets.
By late trading, September was valued at $202.50-$203.50, $6 up on the day, and October at $192-$193, around $5 up. An earlier November trade was seen at $186 before levels rose by a further $$1-$2.

No fresh MTBE trades were seen following Monday's $314 FOB Rotterdam deal for late August. August physical values were still talked around $314, while September offers were heard at $300-$305 and bidding in the $298-$300 range.
